layout.hierarchy: Title is largest and bold. The two large matrix diagrams dominate the middle and bottom. Colored column headers, red labels, and the yellow slide-number badge provide secondary visual emphasis. Small annotation boxes on the right support the main equations.

visual_elements.description: Top matrix notation: headers X_1 on yellow, X_2 on cyan, dotted ellipsis, X_n on pink. Under X_1: x_{11}, x_{12}, ..., x_{1d}; under X_2: x_{21}, x_{22}, ..., x_{2d}; under X_n: x_{n1}, x_{n2}, ..., x_{nd}. A horizontal line separates the bottom row of red labels y_1, y_2, ..., y_n.
Blue-bordered Remember box containing red italic heading Remember and the equation y=W^T X = X^T W with W underlined.
Black-bordered box containing In General: N >>> d, with N, >>>, and d emphasized in red.

Bottom-left expanded equation: left column vector y_1, y_2, ..., y_n with red subscript N x 1; equals sign; middle matrix whose first column is all 1s and whose remaining visible cells are x_{11}, x_{12}, ...., x_{1d}; x_{21}, x_{22}, ...., x_{2d}; an ellipsis row; and x_{n1}, x_{n2}, ...., x_{nd}; right weight vector with blue b, then w_1, w_2, ..., w_d and red subscript d+1 x 1.
Gray right-pointing arrow from the bottom-left equation box to the bottom-right definition box.
Bottom-right box containing Y=X W with X and W underlined, then Where: X_{N x d+1} is a matrix and Y_{Nx1} is labels vector.
Small yellow circular slide-number badge with black numeral 3.

colors.title_text: #0000FF for Matrix; #000000 for the remaining title words

typography_notes: Sans-serif slide text with bold title. Math variables are italic and use subscripts. The word Matrix is blue; red is used for labels, emphasis, and dimension subscripts. W, X, and Y are underlined in key equations. No bullet numbering is used.
animation_state: None; the slide appears fully revealed with no partial build.
recreation_brief: Set the slide background to white. Add the title at the top-left: 'Matrix Notation for Linear Regression and Classification (N- Samples)'. Make 'Matrix' blue bold and the rest black bold, about 30-34 pt.
Add a small yellow circle at the top-right with the black number 3.
Add red text 'N Training Samples' on the left side, vertically centered with the top matrix box.

Draw a gray-bordered rectangle in the top-center. Inside, place column headers X_1, X_2, ..., X_n; highlight X_1 yellow, X_2 cyan, and X_n pink. Under each header place the feature entries exactly as x_{11}, x_{12}, ..., x_{1d}; x_{21}, x_{22}, ..., x_{2d}; ...; x_{n1}, x_{n2}, ..., x_{nd}. Add a horizontal line and place red bottom labels y_1, y_2, ..., y_n.
Add a blue-bordered box at the top-right. Put red italic 'Remember' at its top and the equation 'y=W^T X = X^T W' below it, underlining both W letters.
Below that, add a black-bordered box with 'In General: N >>> d'; make N, >>>, and d red.

Draw a gray-bordered rectangle in the bottom-left. Place the column vector y_1, y_2, ..., y_n with red subscript 'N x 1', then an equals sign, then the matrix with first column all 1s and the visible feature entries, then the weight vector with blue b followed by w_1, w_2, ..., w_d and red subscript 'd+1 x 1'.
Add a gray right-pointing arrow between the bottom-left and bottom-right boxes.
Draw a gray-bordered rectangle in the bottom-right. Place 'Y=X W' with X and W underlined, then 'Where: X_{N x d+1} is a matrix' and 'Y_{Nx1} is labels vector'.
Use a sans-serif font for text, italic for math variables, smaller subscript sizing, and keep all spacing aligned with the matrix columns.
